scenes.narration: Zinedine Zidane scored a left-footed volley in the 45th minute of the UEFA Champions League Final on 15 May 2002 at Hampden Park, Glasgow. Real Madrid won 2–1 against Bayer Leverkusen.
scenes.visual_requirement: Archive-style photo collage or illustrated graphic

scenes.narration: The goal was voted the greatest goal in Champions League history in a poll conducted by UEFA in 2012.

research_items.fact: Zinedine Zidane scored a left-footed volley in the 45th minute of the UEFA Champions League Final on 15 May 2002 at Hampden Park, Glasgow. Real Madrid won 2–1 against Bayer Leverkusen.
The goal was voted the greatest goal in Champions League history in a poll conducted by UEFA in 2012.
